turn.speaker: Customer
turn.content: I'd like to book a cleaning service to my apartment, so I can sign off with landlord and get my deposit back.

turn.speaker: Assistant
turn.content:
That sounds like a move-out cleaning, which is one of our specialties—we help tenants leave the place spotless so landlords have no reason to hold back deposits.
To give you a fair quote, can I ask a few quick questions? - How many bedrooms and bathrooms does the apartment have? - What’s the general condition right now—lightly lived-in, or needing a deeper scrub (for example, heavy kitchen/oven buildup, soap scum, carpets, etc.)? - Is the apartment mostly empty already, or do you still have some belongings inside?
Once I know a bit more, I can share a flat-rate range for you. Also, what date are you hoping to have the cleaning done by?

turn.speaker: Customer
turn.content: 1. the aparment is a 1b1b, 750 sqt, 1 bath room , 1 kicthen, 1 living room and a bed room 2. need deeper scrub 3. I still have some belongs inside, but i will ensure remove them before you arrive

turn.speaker: Assistant
turn.content:
Thank you—that’s very helpful. For a 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment around 750 sq. ft. needing a deeper scrub, move-out cleanings like this typically fall in the $160–$220 flat-rate range. The final rate depends on how much buildup there is in the kitchen and bathroom, since those usually take the most time.
✔️ This would include: - Full bathroom scrub (tile, tub, sink, toilet, fixtures) - Kitchen detail (appliances inside/out if emptied, cabinets wiped, counters, sink, stove/oven scrubbed) - Floors throughout (vacuuming and mopping) - Dusting of surfaces, baseboards, windowsills - Spot-cleaning walls/doors if needed
We accept Zelle, Cash App, Cash, or Venmo—whichever is easiest for you.
Would you like me to check availability for you? What day works best for your move-out cleaning?

turn.speaker: Assistant
turn.content:
Great! Thanks for confirming. What days/times work best for you? (e.g., weekdays mornings, weekends, ASAP, etc.) I’ll check our schedule around those times and see what we can offer.
While we do that, just to double-check: is the apartment located in Newark, NY (zip code 14513)? And do you prefer we bring our own supplies & equipment or use ones you have?

turn.speaker: Assistant
turn.content:
Got it — we’ll do our best to fit you in right away. Since this is a deeper move-out cleaning and time-sensitive, I’d recommend calling Lisa directly at (585) 410-3727 so she can confirm the earliest available slot for you.
In the meantime, I can note your request as: - 1 bed / 1 bath, 750 sq. ft. - Move-out deep cleaning - Apartment will be empty at service time - ASAP scheduling
Would you like me to tentatively note you down for the $160–$220 range so Lisa can finalize with you over the phone when she confirms timing?
